verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout. The 'THE US VIDEO GAMES' headline runs right up against the 'IT'S TIME FOR THEM TO BECOME REAL' column. The pink subhead breaks awkwardly, leaving 'CANNOT' alone on its own line. The 3-day-event body copy is too small to read. The symbol row is jammed against the top edge, and the right column is a cramped stack. In B the body copy is squeezed even smaller and crowds against 'BECOME REAL.' with uneven letter spacing, so A is slightly less broken.
